context.body: A Davidic shepherd is promised, followed by covenant of peace language, removal of dangerous animals, security, fruitful land, and recognition of God’s presence.

observations.body: Kingship, shepherding, peace, land, and covenant are drawn together in one restoration scene.

observations.body: The passage keeps Covenant of peace · security · fruitfulness visible within its covenant claim.
